description: This file defines delegates and static methods to dynamically generate getter and setter functions for fields of value types within the Orleans.Serialization.Utilities namespace, leveraging Reflection and IL emission.

classes.name: FieldAccessor
classes.description: Provides static methods to generate getter and setter delegates for fields using Reflection and IL code emission.

methods.name: GetGetter
methods.description: Returns a delegate to get the value of a specified field, either by reference or value.

methods.name: GetValueGetter
methods.description: Public method to retrieve a getter delegate for a field, with the option of passing by reference.

methods.name: GetSetter
methods.description: Returns a delegate to set the value of a specified field for an instance, either by reference or value.

methods.name: GetReferenceSetter
methods.description: Public method to retrieve a setter delegate for a field, with the option of passing by reference.
